Install Vedabase Original

Install as a standalone app and read all books offline, without internet.

iPhone / iPad
Tap Share (square with arrow) then "Add to Home Screen"

Android
Tap ⋮ menu in Chrome, then "Install app"

Windows / Mac
In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar

After installing, all books work offline. Only audio requires internet.
